name: @platform/security-review
description: Security Review Agent. A separate, stricter gate than the QA/UX/launch reviewers — it asks 'can the wrong person access, alter, leak, or destroy data?'. Statically audits authentication, authorization, multi-tenant isolation, secrets, injection, privacy/logging leakage, billing enforcement, security headers, and cookies (OWASP ASVS / WSTG / Top 10 / API Top 10), runs the dependency audit, and emits a launch-blocking go/no-go report. Any P0 fails the gate.
